description.value:
Your body is naturally capable of gaining power from those you can eat. You can eat a creature of medium size only if they are willing, unconcious, paralyzed, or otherwise incapacitated.

  • You learn all Techniques, Trained Features, and Languages of the assimilated. If the assimilated has more Mastery Ranks in a Technique that you know, you gain those Mastery Ranks.
  • If they have any Ability Scores higher than yours you may add +1 to those Ability Scores, this may increase it above your Ability Score Maximum.
    • If none of their Ability Scores surpass yours you gain +1 to whichever Ability Score was their highest.
  • You gain visual quirks resembling the entities that you assimilated.
  • You gain the Fusion Character Tag and lose all benefits from this feature that you have gained if you ever lose this Tag, coughing up those you have assimilated if it is lost.

You may only gain this benefit a number of times equal to your Constitution Modifier.
